steps.assertion: The Batch opens on the focused review surface
steps.text: Open **Expenses > Expense Batches** and choose your Batch. The summary at the top totals what you paid and what the company paid; the **Expenses** tab lists the lines.

steps.assertion: Shared analytics stay editable while the Batch is open
steps.text: The analytic distribution of the Batch is shared by its lines. Change it here and every line that follows the Batch follows the change.

steps.assertion: The context action explains its safe preview behavior
steps.text: **Apply context** previews what would change before it changes anything; a line with its own explicit choice is left alone.

steps.assertion: A real line exception has a compact, specific helper
steps.text: A line that differs from the Batch is marked with a short helper saying what differs. Open the line to align it, or leave it when the difference is intended.

steps.assertion: The expense list has no destructive trash control
steps.text: Nothing in the list deletes an expense.

steps.assertion: Removal is the single explicit line action
steps.text: **Remove from Batch** is the only line action: the expense goes back to your work list unchanged, ready for another Batch.

title: Review a Batch before submitting it
